rows.grounds: optative of bhū, third person singular
past participle of iṣ, qualifying the gift
feminine adjective/noun in apposition with devī
proper name of the goddess in nominative singular

items.question: Does a pleased Bhuvaneśvarī grant the devotee's desired boon?
premises: The gift is the devotee's desired boon.
items.inference: A pleased Bhuvaneśvarī becomes the giver of the devotee's desired boon.
uncertainties: Whether dā is read as adjective or noun in the compound.
items.plain_english: May the pleased goddess Bhuvaneśvarī become the giver of the desired boon to him.
